farm_steps: Open a fresh wallet for this farm and load it with $10 of ETH on Ethereum for gas, keeping the seed phrase offline. Cost: $10 of ETH plus about $8 of gas to set up. Time: 10 minutes.
Mint $50 of the protocol's yield asset on Ethereum and hold it. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Buy $25 more of the yield asset through Vault Street once a week. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Deepen the position: add $25 more to the Vault Street position on Ethereum so the activity is not a single deposit. Cost: $25 of capital and about $2 of gas. Time: 15 minutes.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
